title: Draft: IEEE80211-radiotap: fix a bitmask used within a bitmask set
description:
Mask in question is UDI - Part of "NDP PS-Poll 2MHz".
Also fix a spelling mistake and some indentation.

notes.body: Mask change is for hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_udi_2m at line 7927, but I couldn't find the right spec/header-file.  Could someone verify this change, and/or point me at a reference for these fields?  @guyharris ?  @WFA-achuang ?
May be change to 2 commit (one with indent and other for fix mask ?)

I can split out the indent (which is annoying, because most of the hf array used tabs, but the code itself, spaces...), but we can wait a bit for any help in checking the field
 definition.  There was also the spelling fix ("beamfording")
split or not ? (for backport to 4.2 and may be other release ?)

The mask of this header field should be 0x1FFE000000.
According to ndp_ps_poll_2m_headers:
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_type_3bit,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_ra,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_ta,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_preferred_mcs_2m,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_udi_2m,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_2m_unused,
  &hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_bw,

hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_ps_poll_preferred_mcs_2m mask = 0x0001E00000
hf_radiotap_s1g_ndp_2m_unused mask = 0x2000000000

In our local branch, the definition is 0x1FFE000000.
I can not find the definition in radiotap.org. I will check where can find the definition.
last mail on radiotap archive is https://lore.kernel.org/radiotap/0a24ce293e808b94f1057b68159d95ebffb8634e.camel@sipsolutions.net/T/#u

The most of definition is in 802.11 SPEC 23.3.12 S1G PHY NDP CMAM PPDUs.
I am checking with Intel about radiotap changes

The radiotap support in sniffer driver is not from Intel.
There are difference between current implementation and WFA proposal.
WFA is checking with sniffer testbed provider if they can modify radiotap S1G definition.

The better solution should be to add s1g ndp information in S1G header, not in 0-length-PSDU.
Current implementation is to dissect s1g ndp in 0-length-PSDU header.
It will require requalification if there is new sniffer driver update.
WFA doesn't expect any change or requirement in short term.
Our plan is to back out s1g definition/field in upstream.
If there is any comment/concern please let me know.

If there is no comment/concern I will back out the changes about S1G NDP.
Please submit this merge request.
I will remove S1G NDP changes based on this merge request.

Hi Albert, sorry for not responding earlier.  I really don't use radiotap - I was just guessing what a consistent value would be in the hope of making it better for people who do.  What would you like to do?

Hi Martin,

Please submit this merge request.
I will back out the changes about S1G NDP because there is some problem about S1G NDP radiotap definition and implementation.
